notes: The appositional even at t042 is added: the phrase it introduces carries no object marker, and the clause's one marker stands on the fronted Them (rule 16).
All four assimilated or written articles in the colour list are unrepresented, the ASV writing no the for any of them.
The participial recta take of the … with their supplied the's under rules 19 and 15, and the two anarthrous substantival participles take them that / those that under rule 46, headed on the lexeme.
